# Law Office of Melinda J. Helbock, A.P.C.

> San Diego-based personal injury law firm specializing in car accidents, medical malpractice, wrongful death, product liability, and defective drug claims.

Melinda J. Helbock leads a comprehensive personal injury practice covering motor vehicle accidents, workplace injuries, premises liability, medical negligence, and mass tort litigation throughout San Diego County and California. The firm has recovered millions in verdicts and settlements across diverse injury categories.
